bio.text: Michael Bahry announced in June 2026 a drive to gather the 1,000 signatures needed to appear on the ballot as an independent candidate for U.S. Senate in Rhode Island, the seat held by Democratic Sen. Jack Reed.
Bahry is a visiting lecturer at Salve Regina University, teaching theology there for three years, and is a former construction executive. The candidate lives in East Providence.
According to the campaign, Bahry began a career as a laborer and carpenter, earned a bachelor's degree from Providence College, and completed two graduate degrees in theological and biblical studies.
The campaign also says Bahry founded the Providence nonprofit Fifty-Three: Five in 2014.

sources.title: Salve Regina lecturer Michael Bahry launches independent U.S. Senate bid
